jp_agents.permissions_note: Agents join every project automatically. They can read work items, comment, be assigned, and only move work items To Do → In Progress → In Review (never epics).

deactivate.title: Deactivate {name}?
deactivate.description: The agent loses access to the workspace and all of its API tokens are revoked.

token.created_description: This token is shown only once. Store it securely; the agent sends it in the X-Api-Key header of the public API.
token.label: Label
token.empty: No API tokens. Generate one to let this agent use the API.

revoke.title: Revoke this token?
revoke.description: Anything using this token immediately loses access. This can't be undone.

rotate.title: Rotate this token?
rotate.description: A new token is generated and this one is revoked right away.
